text:
jess_procurement: Vendor 'NordicCompute' emailed: H100 shipment for FRA delayed ~4 weeks due to missing import license. They can split the shipment but carrier needs go-ahead. Need decision: expedite air (expensive) vs split sea+air (phased) + RMA staging.
liam_sre: Cluster headroom in eu-west-1 edge pools is ~8%. If we push non-critical experiments to us-west temporarily we can cover ~60% of impact. What's the cost delta for air?
jess_procurement: Air uplift quoted at +22% per unit, plus customs broker fee ~€120/unit. Sea split reduces uplift to +6% but adds 2-3 week lag. Vendor also offered to swap 20% of order for A100s at list -15% as temporary substitution.
anya_logistics: For phased returns/RMA: we can receive partial batch in FRA depot, stage serial reconciliation, and release refurbished replacements to the Dedicated pool. But need pre-approved customs docs and an SIR (shipping instruction ref).
sam_infra: Quick data point: if we accept A100 swap for 20% of units, perf impact for our open-inference workload is ~12% higher latency but cost per token down. Could we route high-latency tolerant jobs to A100s? :thinking:
liam_sre: yes. Also propose throttling batch retrains, and enabling tighter batching on H100s to stretch capacity. Ops-bot: "edge-cpu-queue" alerts fired 3x in last hour — pushing load off GPUs helps.
jess_procurement: Can we ask vendor for air uplift cap? I'll push for +12% cap and waive broker fee if we accept phased sea portion. Also asking for prepaid RMA labels for DOA units to avoid depot delays.
anya_logistics: Important: depot in AMS requires PO number on AWB or they hold shipment. If we go split-shipment, need separate AWBs and updated manifests. Snippet vendor sent:
```
AWB: 123-45678901
PO: RW-2025-998
SKU: H100-900GB x80 (split: 16 air)
```
liam_sre: I'll draft routing plan: 1) Accept A100 swap for 16 units -> routed to eu-west-1 canary pool 2) Push non-critical jobs to us-west until phased sea arrival 3) Reserve 24 slots in FRA depot for RMA staging
jess_procurement: Sounds good. Final ask: vendor needs decision by EOD CET. If ok, I authorize phased acceptance and instruct finance to provision expedited uplift budget up to +14% per unit. Anyone object?
sam_infra: No objection. Approve on infra side.
liam_sre: +1. I'll update runbooks and add temporary model-slicing flags.
anya_logistics: I'll confirm AWB and prebook depot slots, and request prepaid RMA labels. Will post the updated manifest when confirmed.
ops-bot: deployment-bot: canary rollout queued for 03:00 UTC to apply routing changes.
